update_policy: Add a feature only with a doc_url opened against current official Microsoft documentation. Set status to deprecated when that documentation says the name was renamed, retired, or is legacy. Do not add a name because a model used it. Single-word aliases match only near a Copilot cue; multi-word aliases match on their own. A preview row is blocked unless the lab or the uploaded manual contains one of requires_any.

retrieval.note: When the flag is on, each doc_url may be fetched to confirm the canonical name is still on the page. The lab writer does not fetch unless the flag is set. Tests inject a fetcher and must not call the network.

features.availability: Producto. Chat de trabajo con protección de datos comercial y, con licencia, acceso a datos de Microsoft 365.

features.availability: Producto que incorpora a Power Virtual Agents. Sirve para crear y publicar agentes.

features.availability: Agente de Microsoft Copilot para análisis de datos. Está en Agentes. Se le adjuntan archivos.

features.availability: Superficie de Microsoft 365 Copilot para crear agentes declarativos con lenguaje natural, la pestaña Configure o una plantilla. Entrada: New agent.
